status: retained: batched replay position and stream-handoff fix; rejected: all speed experiments in this report
scope: Qwen27B independent-session batched rollback/replay correctness. C1 kernels, controller, sampling and the prior qualified C1 speed table are unchanged. Short Q4-target/Q4-draft speed follow-ups are retained only as rejection evidence.
retained: ForwardTokenBatch joins each non-coordinator session stream after any capture-disable update. This covers queued recurrent replay and capture-flag writes before the coordinator reads or overwrites session state.

When replay capture is active, the coordinator reuses the existing token scratch buffer after embedding to stage the actual per-session positions. Each recurrent launch receives its own row of that position buffer. The scalar token/position buffer layout is not valid for independent-session batches.

The existing target fixture covers both ordinary C3 decoding and growing-prefix rollback/replay, mixed cache capacities, all coordinators and a replay-ring crossing. It reuses each mode's scalar full-vocabulary oracle; no maintained executable, tool or execution switch is added.

before.result: ordinary C3 control passes; growing-prefix C3 replay fails with changed target logits

profile_context.interpretation: The preceding profile still identifies exact quantized projections as the major cost. This pass does not claim a new kernel or C1 speed gain; no new profile was needed to qualify the batched state fix.

rejected_experiments.name: Position-specific acceptance estimates
rejected_experiments.algorithm: Seven conditional estimates initialized to 0.75; observed success updates 0.75*p+0.25, first observed rejection updates 0.75*p, and the unobserved suffix ages 1% toward 0.75. Choose expected emitted tokens 1+sum(cumulative products) divided by the existing cost curve. Proposal/verifier/sampler operators unchanged. Array persistence was implemented for the pilot and then fully reverted.
rejected_experiments.reason: Prose acceptance percentage rises but accepted progress per verification round falls. Prose loses 2.61%, JSON loses 2.13%; repetition is flat. All six complete greedy continuations match AR. Broader state/sampling qualification was not run because speed failed.

rejected_experiments.name: Remove C1 save/restore CPU waits
rejected_experiments.algorithm: Remove host synchronization after queued recurrent-state saves/restores and join streams at the batched handoff when capture or restore is pending. This experimental removal and conditional handoff are fully reverted. The retained correctness fix instead keeps the old C1 waits and joins every non-coordinator stream.
rejected_experiments.reason: Two samples per binary in ABBA order show prose -0.23%, JSON -0.28%, repetition -0.36%, with every continuation and all acceptance/round statistics unchanged. No speed gain demonstrated; no profile or broad model suite was spent on this rejected wait-removal candidate.

speed.method: Q4 target/Q4 draft, C1, greedy. Adaptive raw JSON/prose TG300: two timed samples per binary in ABBA order, 128-token raw prose warmup per binary excluded. Fixed-7 repetition chat TG128: two paired samples per binary in ABBA order. Includes prefill, excludes model loading. All IDs checked against preceding qualified AR references; scalar code unchanged.

limits: The maintained C3 model-API fixture qualifies batched state handoffs and growing-prefix replay; it does not establish complete C>1 speculative HTTP serving parity or throughput.

The fix adds synchronization at cross-session stream handoffs and stages positions only during active replay capture. C>1 throughput has not been refreshed. C1 operator paths and their previous speed table are unchanged.
Greedy exactness against Gufo AR and exact intermediate checks do not independently establish original-target/checkpoint-conversion or MTP quality.
Rejected speed probes are short depth-zero experiments, not a significance study or a depth/concurrency matrix. No new speed route is kept.
Draft operators, sampling/controllers, CLI wiring and persistent formats are unchanged by the retained fix; their broader matrices were not repeated.
The original FP4 headline goal of 65.6 JSON/26.1 prose decode-only remains unmet. The 75-question capability comparison was not run.
